map.文本框绘制在线工具，用 ASCII/Unicode 边框字符为文本包裹各种样式文: Online text box drawing tool that wraps text in boxes of various styles using ASCII/Unicode border characters. Ideal for terminal output, document decoration, and chat formatting, with one-click copy and fully browser-based processing.
map.内容宽 = max(各行显示宽度) + 2 × 左右边距；上下边框长度 = 内容: Content width = max(display width of all lines) + 2 × horizontal padding; top and bottom border length = content width; total rows = number of text lines + 2 × vertical padding + 2 (top and bottom borders)
map.显示宽度按\"视觉宽度\"计算：CJK 全角字符计 2 列、半角计 1 列，这是: Display width is measured as "visual width": CJK full-width characters count as 2 columns and half-width as 1 column, which is the key to keeping Chinese character art aligned; counting code points instead makes lines containing Chinese noticeably too short. The left and right padding apply symmetrically to every line, so the content width follows the longest line and shorter lines are padded with spaces to the same width. In title mode, "ToolBox" is centered and occupies the middle of the border, where the decorative line is broken by the title without changing the total width. Paste the copied result into a monospace environment (code editor, terminal), since proportional fonts will still misalign it.

map.为什么框对不齐？: Why Does the Box Look Misaligned?
map.框线依赖等宽字体（monospace）；中文在部分环境按 2 字符宽、英文 1: Box drawing relies on a monospace font; Chinese counts as 2 units in some environments and English as 1, so you need CJK-aware rendering or manual padding spaces to align it.
map.双线和圆角有吗？: Are Double and Rounded Borders Available?
map.有。可切换单线（─│）、双线（═║）与圆角字符集，按展示平台字体支持选择。: Yes. You can switch between single-line (─│), double-line (═║), and rounded character sets, depending on what the display platform's font supports.
